answer: Hardware attestation deters Sybil attacks by requiring agents to execute within secure enclaves. To access each terrace of the network, an identity must present proofs rooted in the onyx silicon of genuine chips. Because software cannot emulate these roots, an attacker incurs physical procurement costs rather than deploying a raven flock of synthetic peers. However, this reliance on specialized hardware privileges central chipmakers and remains vulnerable to side-channel exploits.
